text: Webex is a Cisco brand: Cisco's fiscal 2026 Form 10-K lists the Webex Suite as part of its Collaboration portfolio.

source.name: Cisco Systems, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended July 25, 2026 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Our Collaboration portfolio consists of our Webex Suite, Collaboration Devices, Contact Center and Communication Platform as a Service (CPaaS) offerings.
source.note: SEC EDGAR serves 403 to the CI checker's user agent; the page was opened by hand and the quote copied from it.
